references.text: The preceding description of the cities and areas assigned to the tribe of Dan, which verse 48 summarizes as Dan's inheritance.
The beginning of the distribution of the land among the tribes of Israel, of which Joshua 19:48 is part of the conclusion.
Dan's descendants were counted in the census, and this is the tribe that received the inheritance described in Joshua 19.
Dan's birth as Jacob's son, the ancestor of the tribe of Dan who received this inheritance.
The Danites sought new territory because their original inheritance, described in Joshua 19, was insufficient for them.
The Levites received cities from the inheritance of the tribe of Dan, showing how the heritage was further distributed.
